<!DOCTYPE html>
<!-- saved from url=(0233)file:///D:/%E6%B5%8F%E8%A7%88%E5%99%A8%E4%B8%8B%E8%BD%BD%E5%86%85%E5%AE%B9/%E8%A5%BF%E5%AE%89%E6%9C%BA%E5%9C%BAT5%E5%95%86%E5%8A%A1%E5%87%BA%E8%A1%8C%E6%89%8B%E5%86%8C_%E4%BA%A4%E4%BA%92%E6%9B%B4%E6%96%B0%E7%BB%88%E7%89%88%20(1).html -->
<html lang="zh-CN"><head><meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=UTF-8">
    
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
    <title>西安机场T5商务出行手册｜MIXC AIR</title>
    <style>
      :root {
        --navy: #082f54;
        --blue: #517181;
        --ink: #17313e;
        --gold: #e5ca53;
        --mint: #e8f2f0;
        --pale: #f4f7f7;
        --line: #d7e1e2;
        --muted: #60747e;
        --green: #147661;
        --red: #a45145;
        --white: #fff;
        --r: 18px;
        --shadow: 0 14px 38px rgba(8, 47, 84, 0.1);
      }
      * {
        box-sizing: border-box;
      }
      html {
        scroll-behavior: smooth;
      }
      body {
        margin: 0;
        background: var(--pale);
        color: var(--ink);
        font:
          16px/1.6 "PingFang SC",
          "Microsoft YaHei",
          Arial,
          sans-serif;
      }
      button,
      input,
      select {
        font: inherit;
      }
      button {
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      button:focus-visible,
      a:focus-visible {
        outline: 3px solid var(--gold);
        outline-offset: 2px;
      }
      .hidden {
        display: none !important;
      }
      .top {
        height: 68px;
        position: fixed;
        z-index: 50;
        inset: 0 0 auto;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        padding: 0 clamp(16px, 4vw, 58px);
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96);
        backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      }
      .brand {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 11px;
        font-weight: 900;
        color: var(--navy);
      }
      .brand b {
        display: grid;
        place-items: center;
        width: 37px;
        height: 37px;
        border-radius: 10px;
        background: var(--navy);
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 13px;
      }
      .top-logo,
      .page-logo img {
        width: 214px;
        height: 43px;
        object-fit: contain;
        object-position: right center;
        mix-blend-mode: multiply;
        opacity: 0.74;
      }
      .top-actions {
        display: flex;
        gap: 8px;
      }
      .btn {
        min-height: 44px;
        padding: 9px 15px;
        border: 1px solid var(--navy);
        border-radius: 10px;
        background: #fff;
        color: var(--navy);
        font-weight: 800;
      }
      .btn.primary {
        background: var(--navy);
        color: #fff;
      }
      .btn.gold {
        border-color: var(--gold);
        background: var(--gold);
        color: #22333d;
      }
      .btn.danger {
        border-color: var(--red);
        color: var(--red);
      }
      .btn.sm {
        min-height: 35px;
        padding: 6px 11px;
        font-size: 13px;
      }
      main {
        padding-top: 68px;
      }
      .page {
        position: relative;
        min-height: calc(100svh - 68px);
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        padding: 56px clamp(16px, 4vw, 58px) 100px;
      }
      .page:nth-child(even) {
        background: #fff;
      }
      .wrap {
        width: min(100%, 1420px);
        margin: auto;
      }
      .page-logo {
        position: absolute;
        right: clamp(18px, 4vw, 58px);
        top: 28px;
      }
      .eyebrow {
        margin: 0 0 9px;
        color: #52717c;
        font-size: 13px;
        font-weight: 900;
        letter-spacing: 0.13em;
      }
      .eyebrow:before {
        content: "";
        display: inline-block;
        width: 22px;
        height: 2px;
        margin: 0 9px 4px 0;
        background: var(--gold);
      }
      h1,
      h2,
      h3,
      p {
        margin-top: 0;
      }
      h1 {
        max-width: 760px;
        margin-bottom: 13px;
        color: var(--navy);
        font-size: clamp(40px, 5.5vw, 66px);
        line-height: 1.09;
        letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      }
      h2 {
        margin-bottom: 10px;
        color: var(--navy);
        font-size: clamp(30px, 3.4vw, 45px);
        line-height: 1.18;
        letter-spacing: -0.025em;
      }
      h3 {
        margin-bottom: 6px;
        line-height: 1.34;
      }
      .lead {
        max-width: 820px;
        color: var(--muted);
        font-size: clamp(16px, 1.55vw, 20px);
      }
      .micro {
        color: var(--muted);
        font-size: 13px;
      }
      .card {
        border: 1px solid var(--line);
        border-radius: var(--r);
        background: var(--white);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      }
      .hero {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1.08fr 0.92fr;
        gap: 22px;
        margin-top: 26px;
      }
      .entry {
        padding: 24px;
        background: var(--navy);
        color: #fff;
      }
      .traveller-types {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        gap: 12px;
      }
      .traveller {
        min-height: 200px;
        padding: 19px;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
        border-radius: 15px;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
        color: #fff;
        text-align: left;
      }
      .traveller.active {
        border-color: var(--gold);
        background: rgba(229, 202, 83, 0.13);
        box-shadow: inset 0 -4px 0 var(--gold);
      }
      .traveller .n,
      .flow .n {
        display: grid;
        place-items: center;
        width: 29px;
        height: 29px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: var(--gold);
        color: #20323d;
        font-size: 12px;
        font-weight: 900;
        line-height: 1;
      }
      .traveller h3 {
        margin: 15px 0 5px;
        font-size: 22px;
      }
      .traveller p {
        margin: 0;
        color: #d7e4eb;
        font-size: 14px;
      }
      .entry-form {
        margin-top: 13px;
        padding: 16px;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
        border-radius: 14px;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      }
      .entry-form h3 {
        color: #fff;
      }
      .entry-form p {
        color: #d9e5ec;
        font-size: 14px;
      }
      .entry-tabs {
        display: flex;
        gap: 7px;
        margin-bottom: 12px;
      }
      .tab {
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: transparent;
        color: #dce9f0;
        padding: 7px 11px;
        font-size: 13px;
        font-weight: 800;
      }
      .tab.active {
        background: #fff;
        color: var(--navy);
      }
      .fields {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        gap: 10px;
      }
      .field label {
        display: block;
        margin-bottom: 5px;
        color: #dce9f0;
        font-size: 13px;
        font-weight: 800;
      }
      .field input,
      .field select {
        width: 100%;
        min-height: 46px;
        padding: 8px 10px;
        border: 0;
        border-radius: 8px;
        color: var(--ink);
      }
      .scan-row {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 8px;
      }
      .scan-row input {
        display: none;
      }
      .scan-status {
        min-height: 20px;
        margin: 10px 0 0;
        color: #dce9f0;
        font-size: 13px;
      }
      .flowbox {
        padding: 23px;
      }
      .flowbox h3 {
        color: var(--navy);
        font-size: 22px;
      }
      .flow {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
        gap: 8px;
        margin: 19px 0;
      }
      .flow > div {
        position: relative;
        padding: 0 7px;
        text-align: center;
      }
      .flow .n {
        margin: 0 auto 9px;
      }
      .flow b {
        display: block;
        color: var(--navy);
        font-size: 15px;
      }
      .flow span {
        display: block;
        color: var(--muted);
        font-size: 12px;
      }
      .flow > div:not(:last-child):after {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        right: -6px;
        top: 14px;
        width: 12px;
        height: 1px;
        background: var(--line);
      }
      .trip-status {
        padding: 16px;
        border-radius: 12px;
        background: var(--mint);
      }
      .trip-status b {
        color: var(--navy);
      }
      .integration {
        display: flex;
        align-items: flex-start;
        gap: 10px;
        margin-top: 15px;
        padding-top: 14px;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
      }
      .integration i {
        display: grid;
        place-items: center;
        flex: 0 0 27px;
        width: 27px;
        height: 27px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: #f8eec4;
        color: #715a11;
        font-style: normal;
        font-size: 13px;
      }
      .integration p {
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--muted);
        font-size: 13px;
      }
      .connection-brief {
        margin-top: 15px;
        padding-top: 15px;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
      }
      .connection-head {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 10px;
      }
      .connection-head b {
        color: var(--navy);
        font-size: 15px;
      }
      .connection-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        gap: 9px;
        margin-top: 10px;
      }
      .connection-card {
        min-height: 106px;
        padding: 12px;
        border: 1px solid #ccdce2;
        border-radius: 11px;
        background: linear-gradient(145deg, #fff 0%, #eef7f6 100%);
        color: var(--ink);
        text-align: left;
      }
      .connection-card:hover {
        border-color: var(--blue);
      }
      .connection-card i {
        display: grid;
        place-items: center;
        width: 26px;
        height: 26px;
        margin-bottom: 7px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: var(--navy);
        color: #fff;
        font-style: normal;
        font-size: 12px;
        font-weight: 900;
      }
      .connection-card strong {
        display: block;
        color: var(--navy);
        font-size: 14px;
      }
      .connection-card span {
        display: block;
        margin-top: 2px;
        color: var(--muted);
        font-size: 12px;
        line-height: 1.45;
      }
      .connection-result {
        min-height: 40px;
        margin-top: 9px;
        padding: 9px 11px;
        border-radius: 9px;
        background: #edf4f6;
        color: #47646f;
        font-size: 12px;
      }
      .split {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(340px, 0.8fr) 1.2fr;
        gap: 22px;
        margin-top: 22px;
      }
      .control-panel {
        padding: 22px;
        background: var(--navy);
        color: #fff;
      }
      .control-panel h3 {
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 23px;
      }
      .need-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        gap: 9px;
      }
      .need {
        min-height: 84px;
        padding: 12px;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.27);
        border-radius: 12px;
        background: transparent;
        color: #fff;
        text-align: left;
      }
      .need.active {
        border-color: var(--gold);
        background: rgba(229, 202, 83, 0.15);
      }
      .need b {
        display: block;
        font-size: 15px;
      }
      .need small {
        color: #cce0eb;
        font-size: 12px;
      }
      .compact-fields {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        gap: 10px;
        margin-top: 14px;
      }
      .compact-fields label {
        font-size: 13px;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: #d8e5ec;
      }
      .compact-fields select,
      .compact-fields input {
        width: 100%;
        min-height: 43px;
        margin-top: 4px;
        padding: 8px;
        border: 0;
        border-radius: 8px;
      }
      .recommended {
        min-width: 0;
      }
      .reco-head {
        display: flex;
        align-items: end;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 12px;
      }
      .reco-head h3 {
        color: var(--navy);
        font-size: 22px;
      }
      .reco-list {
        display: grid;
        gap: 10px;
        margin-top: 12px;
      }
      .reco {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 39px 78px 1fr auto;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 12px;
        padding: 11px;
        border: 1px solid var(--line);
        border-radius: 13px;
        background: #fff;
      }
      .reco:first-child {
        border-left: 4px solid var(--gold);
      }
      .rank {
        display: grid;
        place-items: center;
        width: 31px;
        height: 31px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: var(--navy);
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 13px;
        font-weight: 900;
        line-height: 1;
      }
      .reco img {
        width: 78px;
        height: 62px;
        border-radius: 9px;
        object-fit: cover;
      }
      .reco b {
        display: block;
        color: var(--navy);
        font-size: 18px;
      }
      .reco span {
        color: var(--muted);
        font-size: 13px;
      }
      .tag {
        display: inline-block;
        margin: 3px 4px 0 0;
        padding: 3px 7px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: #e8f1f5;
        color: var(--navy);
        font-size: 11px;
        font-weight: 900;
      }
      .tag.green {
        background: #e5f2ee;
        color: #147661;
      }
      .map-layout {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 0.72fr;
        gap: 20px;
        margin-top: 18px;
      }
      .map-shell {
        position: relative;
        min-height: 540px;
        overflow: hidden;
        border: 1px solid var(--line);
        border-radius: 18px;
        background: #eaf2f4;
        box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      }
      .map-shell > img {
        width: 100%;
        height: 540px;
        object-fit: contain;
        filter: contrast(1.08) saturate(1.04);
      }
      .route-svg {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .route-svg path {
        fill: none;
        stroke: #f6c44b;
        stroke-width: 2.15;
        stroke-linecap: round;
        stroke-linejoin: round;
        filter: drop-shadow(0 0 3px rgba(246, 196, 75, 0.95));
        stroke-dasharray: 2 7;
      }
      .route-svg .route-glow {
        stroke: #fff0af;
        stroke-width: 5;
        opacity: 0.33;
        filter: blur(1px);
        stroke-dasharray: 1 10;
      }
      .route-svg circle {
        fill: #f6c44b;
        stroke: #fff;
        stroke-width: 3;
      }
      .map-pin {
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 4;
        width: 15px;
        height: 15px;
        margin: -8px;
        border: 3px solid #fff;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: #507586;
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(80, 117, 134, 0.25);
      }
      .map-pin.public {
        background: var(--green);
      }
      .map-pin.active {
        z-index: 6;
        transform: scale(1.42);
        background: var(--gold);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px rgba(229, 202, 83, 0.27);
      }
      .you {
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 7;
        width: 22px;
        height: 22px;
        margin: -11px;
        border: 3px solid #fff;
        border-radius: 6px;
        background: var(--navy);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px rgba(8, 47, 84, 0.18);
        transform: rotate(45deg);
      }
      .you:after {
        content: "当前位置";
        position: absolute;
        left: 15px;
        top: -8px;
        transform: rotate(-45deg);
        padding: 2px 5px;
        border-radius: 4px;
        background: var(--navy);
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 11px;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .map-note {
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 8;
        left: 13px;
        bottom: 13px;
        padding: 8px 10px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: rgba(8, 47, 84, 0.93);
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 12px;
      }
      .map-detail {
        padding: 20px;
      }
      .map-detail img {
        width: 100%;
        height: 166px;
        border-radius: 12px;
        object-fit: cover;
      }
      .map-detail h3 {
        margin: 9px 0 4px;
        color: var(--navy);
        font-size: 25px;
      }
      .map-detail p {
        color: var(--muted);
      }
      .map-detail .actions,
      .actions {
        display: flex;
        gap: 7px;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
      }
      .legend {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 11px;
        margin-top: 11px;
        color: var(--muted);
        font-size: 12px;
      }
      .legend i {
        display: inline-block;
        width: 10px;
        height: 10px;
        margin-right: 3px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: #507586;
      }
      .legend i.pub {
        background: var(--green);
      }
      .legend i.route {
        background: var(--gold);
      }
      .corridor-tabs {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 8px;
        margin: 22px 0 14px;
      }
      .corridor-tab {
        min-height: 41px;
        padding: 8px 14px;
        border: 1px solid var(--line);
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: #fff;
        color: var(--muted);
        font-weight: 900;
      }
      .corridor-tab.active {
        border-color: var(--navy);
        background: var(--navy);
        color: #fff;
      }
      .corridor-head {
        display: flex;
        align-items: end;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 12px;
      }
      .corridor-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
        gap: 14px;
        margin-top: 16px;
      }
      .shop {
        overflow: hidden;
        border: 1px solid var(--line);
        border-radius: 15px;
        background: #fff;
        box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      }
      .shop img {
        width: 100%;
        height: 182px;
        object-fit: cover;
      }
      .shop .copy {
        padding: 15px;
      }
      .shop h3 {
        color: var(--navy);
        font-size: 21px;
      }
      .shop p {
        color: var(--muted);
        font-size: 14px;
      }
      .shop .gate {
        color: #517181;
        font-size: 12px;
        font-weight: 900;
      }
      .resources {
        margin-top: 18px;
        padding: 17px;
      }
      .resources h3 {
        color: var(--navy);
        font-size: 19px;
      }
      .resource-list {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 8px;
      }
      .resource {
        padding: 8px 10px;
        border-radius: 9px;
        background: var(--mint);
        color: var(--ink);
        font-size: 13px;
      }
      .journey {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 0.82fr 1.18fr;
        gap: 20px;
        margin-top: 20px;
      }
      .journey .card {
        padding: 22px;
      }
      .journey h3 {
        color: var(--navy);
        font-size: 22px;
      }
      .journey-preview {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 104px 1fr;
        gap: 12px;
        align-items: center;
        margin: 0 0 16px;
        padding: 10px;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
        border-radius: 12px;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      }
      .journey-preview img {
        width: 104px;
        height: 74px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        object-fit: cover;
      }
      .journey-preview b {
        display: block;
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 15px;
      }
      .journey-preview span {
        display: block;
        margin-top: 3px;
        color: #d7e4eb;
        font-size: 12px;
      }
      .journey-meta {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 7px;
        margin: 0 0 12px;
      }
      .journey-meta span {
        padding: 4px 8px;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
        border-radius: 999px;
        color: #e2edf1;
        font-size: 11px;
      }
      .journey-tools {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 7px;
        margin-top: 15px;
      }
      .journey-tools button {
        border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.32);
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
        color: #fff;
      }
      .timer-card {
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
      }
      .timer-card:before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        width: 290px;
        height: 290px;
        border: 1px solid #d9e8ea;
        border-radius: 50%;
        opacity: 0.8;
      }
      .timer-card > * {
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;
      }
      .timer-kicker {
        padding: 4px 9px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: #e8f4f1;
        color: #15705e;
        font-size: 12px;
        font-weight: 900;
      }
      .timer-meter {
        width: min(76%, 300px);
        height: 6px;
        margin: 15px auto 9px;
        overflow: hidden;
        border-radius: 99px;
        background: #dfeaec;
      }
      .timer-meter b {
        display: block;
        height: 100%;
        width: 0;
        border-radius: inherit;
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0f8069, #e1ad37);
        transition: width 0.35s ease;
      }
      .timer-context {
        min-height: 22px;
        margin: 0 auto 14px;
        color: var(--muted);
        font-size: 12px;
      }
      .timeline {
        display: grid;
        gap: 0;
      }
      .time {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 40px 1fr;
        gap: 11px;
        padding: 10px 0;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
      }
      .time:last-child {
        border: 0;
      }
      .time i {
        display: grid;
        place-items: center;
        width: 29px;
        height: 29px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: var(--navy);
        color: #fff;
        font-style: normal;
        font-size: 12px;
        font-weight: 900;
      }
      .time b {
        display: block;
        color: var(--navy);
      }
      .time span {
        color: var(--muted);
        font-size: 13px;
      }
      .bottom {
        position: fixed;
        z-index: 49;
        left: 50%;
        bottom: 12px;
        display: flex;
        gap: 3px;
        transform: translateX(-50%);
        padding: 5px;
        border-radius: 14px;
        background: rgba(8, 47, 84, 0.96);
        box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
      }
      .bottom a {
        min-width: 82px;
        padding: 8px 10px;
        border-radius: 9px;
        color: #d8e5ea;
        font-size: 12px;
        font-weight: 900;
        text-align: center;
        text-decoration: none;
      }
      .bottom a.active {
        background: #fff;
        color: var(--navy);
      }
      .modal {
        position: fixed;
        z-index: 100;
        inset: 0;
        overflow: auto;
        padding: 28px;
        background: rgba(4, 23, 40, 0.78);
        backdrop-filter: blur(7px);
      }
      .availability {
        width: min(100%, 1000px);
        min-height: 620px;
        margin: 20px auto;
        border-radius: 22px;
        overflow: hidden;
        background: #f6faf9;
        box-shadow: 0 30px 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
      }
      .availability-top {
        display: flex;
        align-items: start;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 15px;
        padding: 25px;
        background: var(--navy);
        color: #fff;
      }
      .availability-top h2 {
        margin: 4px 0 0;
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 33px;
      }
      .availability-top p {
        margin: 0;
        color: #d0e1e9;
      }
      .close {
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
        border-radius: 50%;
        width: 37px;
        height: 37px;
        background: transparent;
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 21px;
      }
      .availability-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        gap: 16px;
        padding: 20px;
      }
      .availability-grid > .card {
        padding: 19px;
        box-shadow: none;
      }
      .status-card {
        display: grid;
        place-items: center;
        min-height: 220px;
        text-align: center;
      }
      .status-ring {
        display: grid;
        place-items: center;
        width: 132px;
        height: 132px;
        border: 10px solid #d9ebe7;
        border-top-color: var(--green);
        border-radius: 50%;
        color: var(--green);
        font-size: 19px;
        font-weight: 900;
      }
      .status-ring.full {
        border-color: #f0dddd;
        border-top-color: var(--red);
        color: var(--red);
      }
      .status-card b {
        display: block;
        margin-top: 12px;
        color: var(--navy);
        font-size: 20px;
      }
      .status-card p {
        margin: 3px 0;
        color: var(--muted);
        font-size: 13px;
      }
      .data-rows {
        display: grid;
        gap: 0;
      }
      .data-row {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 10px;
        padding: 10px 0;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
        font-size: 14px;
      }
      .data-row:last-child {
        border: 0;
      }
      .data-row span {
        color: var(--muted);
      }
      .data-row b {
        color: var(--navy);
        text-align: right;
      }
      .notice {
        margin: 0 20px 20px;
        padding: 12px;
        border-left: 4px solid var(--gold);
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: #fff6d9;
        color: #625528;
        font-size: 13px;
      }
      .modal-actions {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: flex-end;
        gap: 8px;
        padding: 0 20px 22px;
      }
      .photo-dialog {
        width: min(92vw, 780px);
        margin: 34px auto;
        overflow: hidden;
        border-radius: 20px;
        background: #fff;
        box-shadow: 0 28px 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34);
      }
      .photo-dialog img {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        max-height: 68vh;
        object-fit: contain;
        background: #eef3f5;
      }
      .photo-dialog-copy {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 14px;
        padding: 16px 20px;
      }
      .photo-dialog-copy h3 {
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--navy);
      }
      .photo-dialog-copy p {
        margin: 3px 0 0;
        color: var(--muted);
        font-size: 13px;
      }
      .reservation {
        width: min(92vw, 720px);
        margin: 30px auto;
        overflow: hidden;
        border-radius: 22px;
        background: #f5f8f8;
        box-shadow: 0 28px 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34);
      }
      .reservation-head {
        display: flex;
        align-items: flex-start;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 16px;
        padding: 24px;
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #082f54, #0d587a);
        color: #fff;
      }
      .reservation-head h2 {
        margin: 3px 0 0;
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 30px;
      }
      .reservation-head p {
        margin: 0;
        color: #d9e8ee;
      }
      .reservation-body {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 0.82fr;
        gap: 16px;
        padding: 20px;
      }
      .reservation-form,
      .reservation-code {
        padding: 17px;
        border: 1px solid var(--line);
        border-radius: 14px;
        background: #fff;
      }
      .reservation-form label {
        display: block;
        margin-bottom: 7px;
        color: var(--navy);
        font-size: 13px;
        font-weight: 900;
      }
      .reservation-form input {
        width: 100%;
        min-height: 48px;
        padding: 9px 11px;
        border: 1px solid #cbd9dd;
        border-radius: 9px;
        color: var(--ink);
      }
      .reservation-form p {
        margin: 9px 0 15px;
        color: var(--muted);
        font-size: 12px;
      }
      .reservation-code {
        display: grid;
        place-items: center;
        text-align: center;
      }
      .qr-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(21, 5px);
        grid-auto-rows: 5px;
        gap: 1px;
        width: max-content;
        margin: 7px auto 9px;
        padding: 7px;
        border-radius: 9px;
        background: #fff;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(8, 47, 84, 0.1);
      }
      .qr-grid i {
        display: block;
        width: 5px;
        height: 5px;
        background: transparent;
      }
      .qr-grid i.on {
        background: #082f54;
      }
      .reservation-code b {
        color: var(--navy);
      }
      .reservation-code p {
        margin: 3px 0 0;
        color: var(--muted);
        font-size: 12px;
      }
      .toast {
        position: fixed;
        z-index: 130;
        left: 50%;
        bottom: 82px;
        max-width: 88vw;
        transform: translate(-50%, 15px);
        padding: 10px 14px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: #142c3c;
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 14px;
        opacity: 0;
        pointer-events: none;
        transition: 0.18s;
      }
      .toast.show {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translate(-50%, 0);
      }
      .print-note {
        margin-top: 16px;
        color: var(--muted);
        font-size: 13px;
      }
      @media (max-width: 1000px) {
        .hero,
        .split,
        .map-layout,
        .journey {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        }
        .corridor-grid {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        }
        .map-shell,
        .map-shell > img {
          min-height: 430px;
          height: 430px;
        }
      }
      @media (max-width: 680px) {
        .top {
          height: 60px;
          padding: 0 13px;
        }
        .brand span {
          display: none;
        }
        .top-logo {
          width: 152px;
        }
        .top-actions .btn:first-child {
          display: none;
        }
        main {
          padding-top: 60px;
        }
        .page {
          min-height: auto;
          padding: 38px 14px 92px;
        }
        .page-logo {
          top: 18px;
          right: 14px;
        }
        .page-logo img {
          width: 148px;
        }
        .hero,
        .traveller-types,
        .fields,
        .compact-fields,
        .corridor-grid,
        .availability-grid {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        }
        h1 {
          font-size: 40px;
        }
        .entry,
        .flowbox,
        .control-panel {
          padding: 18px;
        }
        .reco {
          grid-template-columns: 34px 60px 1fr;
        }
        .reco img {
          width: 60px;
          height: 55px;
        }
        .reco .btn {
          grid-column: 2/4;
        }
        .reco b {
          font-size: 16px;
        }
        .map-shell,
        .map-shell > img {
          min-height: 330px;
          height: 330px;
        }
        .bottom {
          left: 7px;
          right: 7px;
          transform: none;
          overflow: auto;
          justify-content: space-between;
        }
        .bottom a {
          min-width: 58px;
          padding: 8px 6px;
          font-size: 11px;
        }
        .availability {
          margin: 0;
          border-radius: 0;
        }
        .modal {
          padding: 0;
        }
        .availability-top {
          padding: 20px;
        }
        .availability-top h2 {
          font-size: 28px;
        }
      }
      /* Executive visual refinement: restrained navy, brass and teal hierarchy. */
      .page:nth-child(3n + 1) {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f5f8fa 0%, #edf4f5 100%);
      }
      .entry,
      .control-panel,
      .journey > .card:first-child {
        background: linear-gradient(
          145deg,
          #082f54 0%,
          #0b426b 100%
        ) !important;
      }
      .traveller,
      .need {
        transition:
          border-color 0.18s ease,
          background 0.18s ease,
          transform 0.18s ease;
      }
      .traveller:hover,
      .need:hover,
      .shop:hover,
      .reco:hover {
        transform: translateY(-2px);
      }
      .shop,
      .reco,
      .map-detail,
      .timer-card {
        box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(8, 47, 84, 0.09);
      }
      .map-shell {
        background: #edf6f8;
      }
      .map-note {
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
        box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(8, 47, 84, 0.24);
      }
      .public-emphasis {
        color: #147661;
        font-weight: 900;
      }
      @media print {
        body {
          background: #fff;
          font-size: 12px;
        }
        .top,
        .bottom,
        .modal,
        .toast,
        button {
          display: none !important;
        }
        main {
          padding: 0;
        }
        .page {
          min-height: auto;
          padding: 25px;
          page-break-after: always;
          align-items: flex-start;
        }
        .page-logo {
          display: block;
          top: 19px;
          right: 25px;
        }
        .page-logo img {
          width: 115px;
        }
        .hero,
        .split,
        .map-layout,
        .journey {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        }
        .card,
        .shop {
          box-shadow: none;
        }
        .page:nth-child(even) {
          background: #fff;
        }
        .map-shell {
          min-height: 330px;
        }
        .map-shell > img {
          height: 330px;
        }
        .corridor-grid {
          grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
        }
        .shop img {
          height: 120px;
        }
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <header class="top">
      <div class="brand"><b>T5</b><span>西安机场T5商务出行手册</span></div>
      <img class="top-logo" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="MIXC AIR">
      <div class="top-actions">
        <button class="btn sm" id="print">打印宣发版</button><button class="btn primary sm" id="reset">重新开始</button>
      </div>
    </header>
    <main>
      <section class="page" id="home">
        <div class="page-logo">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="MIXC AIR">
        </div>
        <div class="wrap">
          <p class="eyebrow">MIXC AIR × 西安机场T5</p>
          <h1>商务出行服务</h1>
          <p class="lead">
            依据旅客类型、行程节点与所在区域，匹配可抵达的商户及公共服务资源。出发与到达路径分别设置，避免无关信息干扰。
          </p>
          <div class="hero">
            <div class="card entry">
              <div class="traveller-types">
                <button class="traveller active" data-traveller="departure">
                  <span class="n">01</span>
                  <h3>出发旅客</h3>
                  <p>
                    核验登机时间与登机口，优先生成不影响登机的商务停留建议。
                  </p></button><button class="traveller" data-traveller="arrival">
                  <span class="n">02</span>
                  <h3>到达旅客</h3>
                  <p>
                    仅选择到达出口或当前区域，直接匹配短停、会面与事务处理资源。
                  </p>
                </button>
              </div>
              <div class="entry-form" id="departureForm">
                <div class="entry-tabs">
                  <button class="tab" data-entry="scan">
                    拍照 / 扫码登机牌</button><button class="tab active" data-entry="manual">手动录入</button>
                </div>
                <div id="scanPane" class="hidden">
                  <h3>登机信息核验</h3>
                  <p>
                    上传登机牌后提取航班、登机时间与登机口；识别结果须由旅客确认。
                  </p>
                  <div class="scan-row">
                    <button class="btn primary sm" id="camera">拍照识别</button><button class="btn gold sm" id="upload">上传图片</button><input type="file" id="boardingFile" accept="image/*" capture="environment">
                  </div>
                  <div class="scan-status" id="scanStatus">
                    当前为原型识别入口，正式接入后由航旅纵横校验航班状态。
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div class="fields" id="departureFields">
                  <div class="field">
                    <label>登机时间</label><input id="boarding" type="time">
                  </div>
                  <div class="field">
                    <label>登机口</label><input id="gate" placeholder="如：127">
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="entry-form hidden" id="arrivalForm">
                <h3>到达区域选择</h3>
                <p>
                  到达旅客无需提供登机牌或登机时间。请选择出口或当前所在区域，以便匹配就近服务。
                </p>
                <div class="fields">
                  <div class="field">
                    <label>到达出口 / 当前区域</label><select id="arrivalZone"><option value="central">中央集中区</option><option value="n1">北一指廊</option><option value="n2">北二指廊</option><option value="n3">北三指廊</option><option value="s1">南一指廊</option><option value="s2">南二指廊</option><option value="s3">南三指廊</option><option value="south">南集中区</option><option value="north">北集中区</option><option value="outside">安检外</option></select>
                  </div>
                  <div class="field">
                    <label>预计停留时长</label><select id="arrivalStay">
                      <option value="20">20分钟以内</option>
                      <option value="45" selected="">约45分钟</option>
                      <option value="75">1小时以上</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="card flowbox">
              <h3>服务路径</h3>
              <div class="flow">
                <div>
                  <span class="n">01</span><b>识别客群</b><span>出发或到达</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span class="n">02</span><b>匹配资源</b><span>区域、任务与时间</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span class="n">03</span><b>纳入行程</b><span>查询接待能力</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="trip-status">
                <b id="homeStatus">出发旅客｜请录入登机信息</b>
                <p class="micro" id="homeStatusText">将结合登机时间、登机口和安全缓冲生成建议。</p>
              </div>
              <section class="connection-brief" aria-label="商旅服务接入示意">
                <div class="connection-head">
                  <b>商旅服务接入示意</b><button class="btn primary sm" id="homeCapacity">
                    体验接待余量
                  </button>
                </div>
                <div class="connection-grid">
                  <button class="connection-card" id="flightConnect">
                    <i>航</i><strong>航班信息协同</strong><span>航旅纵横：登机时间、航班动态、登机口与登机状态。</span>
                  </button>
                  <button class="connection-card" id="merchantConnect">
                    <i>店</i><strong>商户服务协同</strong><span>座位余量、接待能力与一键预定；结果以授权接口为准。</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
                <div class="connection-result" id="connectionResult">航班信息协同示意：将由航旅纵横核验登机时间 17:21、登机口 待录入 与航班状态；正式结果以授权接口和现场广播为准。</div>
              </section>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
      <section class="page" id="recommend">
        <div class="page-logo">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="MIXC AIR">
        </div>
        <div class="wrap">
          <p class="eyebrow">行程匹配</p>
          <h2>就近优选</h2>
          <p class="lead">
            需求选择、当前位置与商户推荐合并呈现；调整条件后在同一页面即时更新结果。
          </p>
          <div class="split">
            <aside class="card control-panel">
              <h3>服务偏好</h3>
              <p class="micro" style="color: #d8e5ec">
                选择本次停留的核心事项。
              </p>
              <div class="need-grid">
                <button class="need" data-need="work">
                  <b>事务处理</b><small>邮件、文件与短时办公</small></button><button class="need active" data-need="meeting">
                  <b>商务沟通</b><small>两至三人短时会面</small></button><button class="need" data-need="rest">
                  <b>状态恢复</b><small>放松、补给与恢复</small></button><button class="need" data-need="arrival">
                  <b>到达停留</b><small>会面、等候与衔接</small>
                </button>
              </div>
              <div class="compact-fields">
                <label>当前位置<select id="zone"><option value="central">中央集中区</option><option value="n1">北一指廊</option><option value="n2">北二指廊</option><option value="n3">北三指廊</option><option value="s1">南一指廊</option><option value="s2">南二指廊</option><option value="s3">南三指廊</option><option value="south">南集中区</option><option value="north">北集中区</option><option value="outside">安检外</option></select></label><label id="bufferWrap" class="">安全缓冲<select id="buffer">
                    <option value="15">15分钟</option>
                    <option value="25" selected="">25分钟</option>
                    <option value="35">35分钟</option>
                  </select></label>
              </div>
              <div class="actions" style="margin-top: 15px">
                <button class="btn gold sm" id="showMap">在地图上选择</button>
              </div>
            </aside>
            <section class="recommended">
              <div class="reco-head">
                <div>
                  <h3>匹配结果</h3>
                  <p class="micro" id="recommendInfo">以中央集中区为起点，已预留25分钟安全缓冲。</p>
                </div>
                <button class="btn sm" id="adjust">调整条件</button>
              </div>
